card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 17.9 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, CP Cep: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 85.2 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 3,074 parsecs away.
